headline: Nifty rose while the *broader market lagged*
subline: The frontline ran hard. Smallcaps and the wider tape did not follow.
hero_text: Nifty gained 1.85% with 42 of 50 stocks rising. Across 2,774 NSE stocks, decliners still outnumbered advancers.

why.title: Staples carried the Nifty up
why.desc: 42 of 50 Nifty stocks rose. HUL led at 6.08% and staples did the lifting.

why.title: FIIs and DIIs both came in
why.desc: FII net inflow was Rs 4,479.08 Cr. DIIs added Rs 4,018.72 Cr.

why.title: Wall Street fell sharply
why.desc: S&P 500 fell 2.59% and Nasdaq 3.92%, yet the Nifty still rose.

why.title: Pharma added to the lift
why.desc: Nifty Pharma rose 2.38% and closed near its high of the day.

sector_reasons.FMCG: HUL, Tata Consumer and Nestle led the climb
sector_reasons.Pharma: Closed near its high on a firm bid
sector_reasons.Private Bank: Private lenders carried the bank bid
sector_reasons.Media: Sun TV fell 9.21% and dragged the group
sector_reasons.Metal: Tata Steel, Hindalco and JSW Steel slipped

bonus_text: 1,183 stocks advanced and 1,560 declined, a ratio of 0.76. Nifty Smallcap 100 lost 0.44% while the Nifty 50 rose.
movers_note_gainers: HUL led at 6.08%. Tata Consumer and Nestle made it three staples in the top four.
movers_note_losers: Tata Steel fell 2.27%, the deepest cut. Hindalco and JSW Steel made it three metal names.
watch_text: Tokyo Core CPI lands at 09:00 IST Thursday. Nifty option OI stacks at 25,500 puts and 26,000 calls.
lessons: Breadth was only slightly negative. The decline was narrow.
The frontline and the tail parted ways. Smallcap 100 fell 0.44% while the Nifty jumped.
Steel led the Nifty losers. Tata Steel, Hindalco and JSW Steel all closed lower.
Both big money pools agreed. FIIs and DIIs each added cash on the same day.
alert_text: Tokyo Core CPI is forecast at 3.0% against 2.6% before. The Nifty weekly expiry falls Tuesday 1 December.
cta_headline: Index up, tape split. *Next bell is Thursday*.
cta_sub: More stocks fell than rose. Full wrap every evening, next one after Thursday's close.
next_text: Thursday 26 November opens after a 1.85% jump. Tokyo Core CPI at 09:00 IST is the one scheduled event.
caption_a:
Nifty jumped 1.85% to 25,819.25, yet 1,560 stocks fell against 1,183 that rose.
FMCG led at 3.79%. Media lost 4.44%.
FIIs added Rs 4,479.08 Cr, DIIs Rs 4,018.72 Cr.
Watch: Tokyo Core CPI at 09:00 IST Thursday.
